slides.title: Drought leaves a district without a harvest
slides.body: Abergele woreda, Wag Himra, Amhara region

slides.title: people need emergency food aid
slides.body: Out of 80,874 residents, local officials told Borkena. The cause: El Niño-linked drought.

slides.title: of cultivated land produced no crop
slides.body: Across 17,941 hectares, the woreda agriculture office said. Some kebeles lost their harvest entirely.

slides.title: sheep and goats have died
slides.body: Plus 8,909 cattle and 1,129 camels, from feed and water shortages, the woreda livestock office said.

slides.title: people forced from their homes
slides.body: From 241 households, according to the report. Local leaders are appealing for food, animal feed and veterinary aid.

slides.title: Get food and aid to drought-hit families.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Borkena, citing Abergele woreda officials · Oct 19, 2026
